module_title: Supreme Peaks and the Most Famous Passes
introduction: At this level, we focus on the highest peaks in India and the mountain passes that are repeatedly asked in exams. A 'pass' is a navigable route through a mountain range.

core_concepts.title: Highest Peaks of India
core_concepts.description:
1. **K2 (Godwin Austen):** The highest peak in India (8,611 meters) and the second highest in the world. It is located in the Karakoram Range. (Currently in POK - Pakistan Occupied Kashmir). 
2. **Kangchenjunga:** **Sikkim** (8,586 meters). It is the highest peak situated entirely within undisputed Indian territory (in the Himalayas). It is the third highest peak in the world.

core_concepts.title: Nathu La - Sikkim
core_concepts.description: Connects India (Sikkim) with Tibet (China). It was a major corridor of the ancient **'Silk Route'**. It was sealed after the 1962 Sino-Indian War and re-opened in 2006 for trade.

core_concepts.title: Rohtang Pass - Himachal Pradesh
core_concepts.description: Connects the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti Valleys. The famous **'Atal Tunnel'** (the longest highway single-tube tunnel in the world - 9.02 km) is built under this pass.

important_entities.name: Mount Everest
important_entities.significance: Basic Exam Fact: Mount Everest (8,848.86 meters) is NOT in India! It is located on the border of **Nepal** and Tibet. In Nepal, it is known as 'Sagarmatha'.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: If the question asks for 'India's Highest Peak' and K2 (Godwin Austen) is in the options, select K2. If K2 is NOT in the options, select 'Kangchenjunga'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Nathu = Nathu La. Jail = Jelep La. Both are crucial passes located in Sikkim.

exam_strategy_tips: A guaranteed SSC and Railway question: 'Nathu La pass, which was a part of the ancient Silk Route, is situated in which state?' Answer: Sikkim.
